policies.title: Syrian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule places the Syrian Arab Republic in its prior-to-arrival cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Syrian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, residence, study, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Syrian ordinary passports: Jordan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Syrian visitors must obtain a visa from the closest Jordanian Embassy before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Syrian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's table expressly states that Syria is not eligible for an arrival visa and directs the traveller to obtain a visa before arrival from the closest Jordanian Embassy.
Gateway2Jordan QR registration, restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain separate conditions.

conflicts.explanation: The full suspension retains valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and case-by-case waivers, so it cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
